answer_1.quote: With the advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the emergence of powerful pre-trained vision-language models, several Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable performance in vision-language tasks such as visual question answering and image captioning.
answer_1.outputs: image captions and answers to visual questions

answer_2.quote: ROHE reports two scores: acc and acc+. The acc score represents the proportion of correctly answered question in the positive VQA unit; while the acc+ score reflects the proportion of correctly answered question in both the positive VQA unit and negative VQA unit.
